# Poki
> Free online browser gaming platform with hundreds of instant-play games across action, puzzle, racing, multiplayer, and casual genres.

Poki curates playable web games that run directly in the browser on desktop and mobile, with localized category pages, individual game pages, and discovery hubs for popular genres and themes.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://poki.com/): Main game discovery page featuring popular, new, and trending browser games.
- [English Games Home](https://poki.com/en): English-language landing page for browsing Poki’s catalog.
- [New Games](https://poki.com/en/new): Recently added games and fresh releases on the platform.
- [Popular Games](https://poki.com/en/popular): Widely played and trending titles across Poki.
- [Online Games](https://poki.com/en/online): General hub for free online games playable instantly in browser.

## Multiplayer & Social
- [Multiplayer Games](https://poki.com/en/multiplayer): Real-time competitive and cooperative browser games for multiple players.
- [Two Player Games](https://poki.com/en/two-player): Local and online games designed for two players.
- [IO Games](https://poki.com/en/io): Fast-paced multiplayer survival and arena games with simple controls.
- [Co-op Games](https://poki.com/en/co-op): Cooperative games focused on teamwork and shared objectives.
- [Battle Games](https://poki.com/en/battle): Competitive combat games featuring duels, arenas, and tactical fights.

## Action & Arcade
- [Action Games](https://poki.com/en/action): Reflex-driven games including combat, platforming, and fast-paced challenges.
- [Arcade Games](https://poki.com/en/arcade): Classic-style score chasing and quick-session gameplay experiences.
- [Shooting Games](https://poki.com/en/shooting): Browser shooters ranging from casual blasters to multiplayer FPS titles.
- [Fighting Games](https://poki.com/en/fighting): One-on-one and arena combat games with melee-focused gameplay.
- [Skill Games](https://poki.com/en/skill): Precision and timing-based games testing control and reaction speed.
- [Stickman Games](https://poki.com/en/stickman): Action-heavy stickman games featuring combat, stunts, and physics challenges.

## Racing & Driving
- [Car Games](https://poki.com/en/car): Driving, racing, drifting, and parking games for browser play.
- [Racing Games](https://poki.com/en/racing): Competitive speed-focused games with tracks, traffic, and time trials.
- [Bike Games](https://poki.com/en/bike): Motorcycle and BMX games with stunts, races, and obstacle courses.
- [Truck Games](https://poki.com/en/truck): Heavy vehicle driving games with hauling and off-road challenges.
- [Parking Games](https://poki.com/en/parking): Maneuvering and precision driving games centered on parking tasks.

## Puzzle & Strategy
- [Puzzle Games](https://poki.com/en/puzzle): Logic, matching, and problem-solving games for all ages.
- [Brain Games](https://poki.com/en/brain): Memory, reasoning, and mental challenge games with educational elements.
- [Strategy Games](https://poki.com/en/strategy): Planning-focused games involving tactics, defense, and resource decisions.
- [Thinking Games](https://poki.com/en/thinking): Slower-paced games emphasizing logic and careful problem solving.
- [Math Games](https://poki.com/en/math): Number and arithmetic games blending learning with play.
- [Word Games](https://poki.com/en/word): Vocabulary and spelling games built around letters and language puzzles.

## Adventure & Simulation
- [Adventure Games](https://poki.com/en/adventure): Exploration and quest-driven games with progression and discovery.
- [Simulation Games](https://poki.com/en/simulation): Games modeling activities, jobs, systems, and everyday scenarios.
- [Escape Games](https://poki.com/en/escape): Puzzle adventures focused on clues, locks, and room escape mechanics.
- [Idle Games](https://poki.com/en/idle): Incremental games with passive progression and upgrade systems.
- [Tycoon Games](https://poki.com/en/tycoon): Management and growth games centered on building profitable systems.

## Sports & Casual
- [Sports Games](https://poki.com/en/sports): Competitive sports titles including soccer, basketball, and more.
- [Soccer Games](https://poki.com/en/soccer): Football games featuring matches, penalties, and arcade-style play.
- [Basketball Games](https://poki.com/en/basketball): Hoops games ranging from realistic play to trick-shot challenges.
- [Running Games](https://poki.com/en/running): Endless runners and speed-based obstacle games.
- [Casual Games](https://poki.com/en/casual): Easy-to-start games designed for short, accessible play sessions.

## Creative & Themed
- [Dress Up Games](https://poki.com/en/dress-up): Fashion and styling games with outfits, makeovers, and customization.
- [Cooking Games](https://poki.com/en/cooking): Food preparation and restaurant-themed games with time-management mechanics.
- [Animal Games](https://poki.com/en/animal): Games featuring pets, wildlife, and animal-themed adventures.
- [Minecraft Games](https://poki.com/en/minecraft): Block-building and sandbox-inspired games influenced by Minecraft themes.
- [Roblox Games](https://poki.com/en/roblox): Obby, roleplay, and creator-inspired games associated with Roblox-style play.

## Featured Games
- [Subway Surfers](https://poki.com/en/g/subway-surfers): Endless runner where players dodge obstacles, collect coins, and outrun pursuit.
- [Retro Bowl](https://poki.com/en/g/retro-bowl): Retro-styled American football management and on-field action game.
- [Stickman Hook](https://poki.com/en/g/stickman-hook): Physics platformer about swinging through levels with precise timing.
- [Temple Run 2](https://poki.com/en/g/temple-run-2): Endless running game with turns, jumps, and collectible progression.
- [Moto X3M](https://poki.com/en/g/moto-x3m): Bike stunt game with traps, flips, and time-based level completion.
- [Combat Online 2](https://poki.com/en/g/combat-online-2): Multiplayer first-person shooter with online matches and weapon-based combat.
- [Mr Racer - Car Racing](https://poki.com/en/g/mr-racer-car-racing): Highway racing game focused on speed, traffic dodging, and car progression.
- [Venge.io](https://poki.com/en/g/venge-io): Multiplayer arena shooter with objective-based combat and special abilities.
